name: 🚀 AutoPub Release
concurrency: release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  check-release:
    name: 📦 Check for release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_release: ${{ steps.check.outputs['has-release'] }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.BOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check for release
        id: check
        uses: autopub/autopub-action@5fdc82e84c048a82303de6b5c5a9d027665e73cf # v1.1.1
        with:
          command: check
          autopub-version: "1.0.0a63"
          github-token: ${{ secrets.BOT_TOKEN }}
          extra-plugins: strawberry-autopub-plugins

      - name: Debug info
        run: |
          echo "GitHub ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "has_release: ${{ steps.check.outputs['has-release'] }}"

  publish:
    name: 📦 Publish to PyPI
    needs: check-release
    if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.check-release.outputs.has_release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Debug info
        run: |
          echo "GitHub ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "has_release: ${{ needs.check-release.outputs.has_release }}"

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.BOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Prepare release
        uses: autopub/autopub-action@5fdc82e84c048a82303de6b5c5a9d027665e73cf # v1.1.1
        with:
          command: prepare
          autopub-version: "1.0.0a63"
          extra-plugins: strawberry-autopub-plugins

      - name: Build package
        uses: autopub/autopub-action@5fdc82e84c048a82303de6b5c5a9d027665e73cf # v1.1.1
        with:
          command: build
          autopub-version: "1.0.0a63"
          extra-plugins: strawberry-autopub-plugins

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: autopub/autopub-action@5fdc82e84c048a82303de6b5c5a9d027665e73cf # v1.1.1
        with:
          command: publish
          autopub-version: "1.0.0a63"
          extra-plugins: strawberry-autopub-plugins
          github-token: ${{ secrets.BOT_TOKEN }}
          git-username: botberry
          git-email: bot@strawberry.rocks
        env:
          TYPEFULLY_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TYPEFULLY_API_KEY }}
          TYPEFULLY_SOCIAL_SET_ID: ${{ secrets.TYPEFULLY_SOCIAL_SET_ID }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
